exposure: marine long chain n-3 polyunsaturated fatty acids (LCn-3PUFA) from supplements
cohort: The study included 67,007 women from the Norwegian Mother and Child Cohort Study.
finding: Any intake of seafood above no/rare consumption was associated with a lower prevalence of preterm delivery, with the association being stronger for lean fish than for fatty fish, and supplementary LCn-3PUFA intake was associated only with early preterm delivery.
gest_age: Preterm delivery was defined as before gestational week 37, and early preterm delivery was defined as before 32 gestational weeks.
